instruction: Based on the provided autonomous driving test scenario description, please write the corresponding OpenScenario v2.0 DSL file. Ensure you correctly define the initial speeds, relative positions, and lane relationships for the Ego and Target vehicles.

instances.input: There is a stationary motorcycle ahead, and a stationary car is placed in the left lane.
instances.output:
# 场景: cmr_gvt_onside_test_run
# 描述: 前方同车道有静止摩托车，左侧车道有静止汽车(并排)
# 地图: M499_FTX_suburban.xodr (市郊)

import "$PROJECT_DIR/projectLibs/project_scenario_base/project_base_scenario_model_ssp.osc"
import "$OSC2LIB/scenarios/free_drive/ego_free_drive_auto_gen/ego_free_drive_auto_gen_one_way_road_top.osc"
import "$OSC2LIB/scenarios/free_drive/npc_driving/npc_free_driving_top.osc"

extend test_config:
    set map = "$OSC2LIB/maps/M499_FTX_suburban.xodr"

scenario sut.cmr_gvt_onside_test_run inherits project_base_scenario:
    keep(default scenario_str_generic == "cmr_gvt_onside_test_run")
    
    my_road: one_way_road
    
    # 自车车道
    ego_lane: int with:
        keep(default it == 2)
        keep(it >= 2)
    
    # 起始偏移
    start_offset: length with:
        keep(it <= my_road.length - 150m)
    
    # 自车初始速度
    ego_speed: speed with:
        keep(default it in [20kph, 30kph, 40kph, 50kph, 60kph])
    
    # 静止障碍物相对距离
    obstacle_relative_distance: length with:
        keep(default it == 20m)
    
    # 场景持续时间
    duration_time: time with:
        keep(it >= 10s)

    on @set_up.start:
        call logger.log_info("===== CMR-GVT-OnSide场景参数 =====")
        call logger.log_info("自车初始速度:           $(ego_speed)")
        call logger.log_info("障碍物距离:             $(obstacle_relative_distance)")
        call logger.log_info("场景持续时间:           $(duration_time)")
        call logger.log_info("自车车道:               $(ego_lane)")
    
    do serial():
        set_up: parallel():
            # 自车自由行驶
            ego_free_drive_phase: sut.ego_free_drive_auto_gen_one_way_road() with:
                keep(it.gen_ego_speed_at_start == ego_speed)
                keep(it.ego_road_element == my_road)
                keep(it.gen_min_lanes == ego_lane)
                keep(it.gen_ego_lane_at_start == ego_lane)
                keep(it.gen_ego_lane_at_end == ego_lane)
                keep(it.ego_start_offset == start_offset)
                keep(it.ego_driving_duration == duration_time)
            
            # 同车道前方静止摩托车
            npc_motorcycle_phase: sut.npc_free_driving() with:
                keep(it.npc_relative_position == obstacle_relative_distance)
                keep(it.npc_initial_speed == 0kph)
                keep(it.npc_target_speed == 0kph)
                keep(it.npc_initial_lane == ego_lane)
                keep(it.npc_target_lane == ego_lane)
                keep(it.npc_vehicle_type == motorcycle)
                keep(it.npc_duration == duration_time)
                keep(it.ref_car == sut.car)
            
            # 左侧车道静止汽车(与摩托车并排)
            npc_car_phase: sut.npc_free_driving() with:
                keep(it.npc_relative_position == obstacle_relative_distance)
                keep(it.npc_initial_speed == 0kph)
                keep(it.npc_target_speed == 0kph)
                keep(it.npc_initial_lane == ego_lane - 1)
                keep(it.npc_target_lane == ego_lane - 1)
                keep(it.npc_duration == duration_time)
                keep(it.ref_car == sut.car)

extend top.main:
    do sut.cmr_gvt_onside_test_run()

extend test_additional_parameters:
    const test_index: string

extend test_config:
    set test_name = "cmr_gvt_onside_test_run"
    set additional_parameters.test_index = "auto_20251121_000004"

scenario sut.swerve_test_run inherits project_base_scenario:

    # 起始偏移
    start_offset: length with:
        keep(it <= my_road.length - 150m)

    # 自车速度
    ego_speed: speed with:
        keep(default it == 50kph)

    # NPC速度 (较快)
    npc_speed: speed with:
        keep(default it == 60kph)

    # NPC相对位置 (后方)
    npc_relative_position: length with:
        keep(default it in [-20m..-10m])

    # 变道开始时间 (较早,给自车反应时间)
    lane_change_start_time: time with:
        keep(default it in [2s..4s])

    # 变道持续时间
    lane_change_duration: time with:
        keep(default it in [3s..5s])

    # 测试持续时间
    duration_time: time with:
        keep(it >= lane_change_start_time + lane_change_duration + 5s)

    keep(sut.car.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.allow_opposite_left_side == true)

    on @set_up.start:
        call logger.log_info("ego_speed: $(ego_speed)")
        call logger.log_info("npc_speed: $(npc_speed)")
        call logger.log_info("npc_relative_position: $(npc_relative_position)")
        call logger.log_info("lane_change_start_time: $(lane_change_start_time)")
        call logger.log_info("lane_change_duration: $(lane_change_duration)")
        call logger.log_info("duration_time: $(duration_time)")

    do serial():
        set_up: parallel():
            # 自车在中间车道行驶
            ego_free_drive_phase: sut.ego_free_drive_auto_gen_one_way_road() with:
                keep(it.gen_ego_speed_at_start == ego_speed)
                keep(it.ego_road_element == my_road)

                keep(it.gen_max_lanes == 3)
                keep(it.gen_ego_lane_at_start == 2)
                keep(it.gen_ego_lane_at_end == 2)
                keep(it.ego_start_offset == start_offset)
                keep(it.ego_driving_duration == duration_time)

            # 前方较慢NPC车辆(同车道)
            npc_driving_phase: sut.npc_free_driving() with:
                keep(it.npc_relative_position == self.npc_relative_position)
                keep(it.npc_initial_speed == npc_speed)
                keep(it.npc_target_speed == npc_speed)
                keep(it.npc_initial_lane == 2)
                keep(it.npc_target_lane == 3)
                keep(it.npc_duration == duration_time)
                keep(it.ref_car == sut.car)

    do sut.swerve_test_run()

extend test_additional_parameters:
    const test_index: string

extend test_config:
    set test_name = "swerve_test_run"
    set additional_parameters.test_index = "auto_20251120_170000"

# 场景: 自车以40kph行驶,前方NPC车辆切出,同车道更前方有缓行车辆(15kph)

import "$PROJECT_DIR/projectLibs/project_scenario_base/project_base_scenario_model_ssp.osc"
import "$OSC2LIB/scenarios/free_drive/ego_free_drive_auto_gen/ego_free_drive_auto_gen_one_way_road_top.osc"
import "$OSC2LIB/scenarios/free_drive/npc_driving/npc_cut_out_top.osc"
import "$OSC2LIB/scenarios/free_drive/npc_driving/npc_free_driving_top.osc"

extend test_config:
    set map = "$OSC2LIB/maps/M499_FTX_suburban.xodr"

scenario sut.exit_ttc_02_test_run inherits project_base_scenario:
    keep(default scenario_str_generic == "exit_ttc_02_test_run")

    # 测试道路
    my_road: one_way_road

    # 自车车道
    ego_lane: int with:
        keep(it >= 1)
    
    # NPC目标车道
    npc_target_lane: int with:
        keep(it >= 1)
        keep(default it in [ego_lane - 1, ego_lane + 1])

    # 起始偏移
    start_offset: length with:
        keep(it <= my_road.length - 200m)

    # 行驶速度
    drive_speed: speed with:
        keep(default it == 40kph)

    # NPC相对位置
    npc_relative_position: length with:
        keep(default it == 10m)

    # 变道开始时间
    lane_change_start_time: time with:
        keep(default it in [0s..1s])

    # 变道持续时间
    lane_change_duration: time with:
        keep(default it in [3s..4s])

    # 缓行障碍物相对位置
    obstacle_relative_position: length with:
        keep(default it == 44m)

    # 测试持续时间
    duration_time: time with:
        keep(it >= lane_change_start_time + lane_change_duration + 3s)

    keep(sut.car.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.allow_opposite_left_side == true)

    on @set_up.start:
        call logger.log_info("Ego / NPC speed:         $(drive_speed)")
        call logger.log_info("NPC rel pos:             $(npc_relative_position)")
        call logger.log_info("NPC lane change: start   $(lane_change_start_time)  dur $(lane_change_duration)")
        call logger.log_info("Slow vehicle rel pos:    $(obstacle_relative_position)")
        call logger.log_info("Scenario duration:       $(duration_time)")
        call logger.log_info("Ego lane: $(ego_lane)  NPC target lane: $(npc_target_lane)")

    do serial():
        set_up: parallel():
            # 自车自由行驶阶段
            ego_free_drive_phase: sut.ego_free_drive_auto_gen_one_way_road() with:
                keep(it.gen_ego_speed_at_start == drive_speed)
                keep(it.ego_road_element == my_road)
                keep(it.gen_min_lanes == 2)
                keep(it.gen_ego_lane_at_start == ego_lane)
                keep(it.ego_start_offset == start_offset)
                keep(it.ego_driving_duration == duration_time)

            # NPC切出阶段
            npc_cut_out_phase: sut.npc_cut_out() with:
                keep(it.npc_relative_position == npc_relative_position)
                keep(it.npc_initial_speed == drive_speed)
                keep(it.npc_target_speed == drive_speed)
                keep(it.npc_initial_lane == ego_lane)
                keep(it.npc_target_lane == npc_target_lane)
                keep(it.npc_cut_out_start_time == lane_change_start_time)
                keep(it.npc_cut_out_duration == lane_change_duration)
                keep(it.npc_duration == duration_time)
                keep(it.ref_car == sut.car)

            # 缓行车辆阶段 (15kph)
            obstacle_phase: sut.npc_free_driving() with:
                keep(it.npc_relative_position == obstacle_relative_position)
                keep(it.npc_initial_speed == 15kph)
                keep(it.npc_target_speed == 15kph)
                keep(it.npc_initial_lane == ego_lane)
                keep(it.npc_target_lane == ego_lane)
                keep(it.npc_duration == duration_time)
                keep(it.ref_car == sut.car)

extend top.main:
    do sut.exit_ttc_02_test_run()

extend test_additional_parameters:
    const test_index: string

extend test_config:
    set test_name = "exit_ttc_02_test_run"
    set additional_parameters.test_index = "auto_20251121_000006"

# 场景: blind_merge_test_run
# 描述: 盲区变道场景，自车向左变道，目标车道后方有NPC车辆
# 地图: M499_FTX_suburban.xodr (市郊)

import "$PROJECT_DIR/projectLibs/project_scenario_base/project_base_scenario_model_ssp.osc"
import "$OSC2LIB/scenarios/free_drive/ego_free_drive_auto_gen/ego_free_drive_auto_gen_one_way_road_top.osc"

extend test_config:
    set map = "$OSC2LIB/maps/M499_FTX_suburban.xodr"

scenario sut.blind_merge_test_run inherits project_base_scenario:
    keep(default scenario_str_generic == "blind_merge_test_run")
    
    my_road: one_way_road
    
    # 自车起始车道
    ego_lane_start: int with:
        keep(it >= 2)
    
    # 自车目标车道(左侧)
    ego_lane_target: int with:
        keep(it == ego_lane_start - 1)
    
    # NPC车道(与目标车道相同)
    npc_lane: int with:
        keep(it == ego_lane_target)
    
    # 起始偏移
    start_offset: length with:
        keep(it <= my_road.length - 200m)
    
    # 自车速度
    ego_speed: speed with:
        keep(default it == 90kph)
    
    # NPC速度
    npc_speed: speed with:
        keep(default it == 90kph)
    
    # NPC相对位置(后方盲区)
    npc_relative_position: length with:
        keep(default it in [-20m..-10m])
    
    # 场景持续时间
    duration_time: time  with:
        keep(default it in [3s..10s]) # 至少要模拟3s

    keep(sut.car.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.allow_opposite_left_side == true)

    on @set_up.start:
        call logger.log_info("===== BlindMerge场景参数 =====")
        call logger.log_info("自车速度:               $(ego_speed)")
        call logger.log_info("NPC速度:                $(npc_speed)")
        call logger.log_info("NPC相对位置:            $(npc_relative_position)")
        call logger.log_info("场景持续时间:           $(duration_time)")
        call logger.log_info("变道:                   车道$(ego_lane_start) → 车道$(ego_lane_target)")
    
    do serial():
        set_up: parallel():
            # 自车向左变道
            ego_free_drive_phase: sut.ego_free_drive_auto_gen_one_way_road() with:
                keep(it.gen_ego_speed_at_start == ego_speed)
                keep(it.ego_road_element == my_road)
                keep(it.gen_min_lanes == 2)
                keep(it.gen_ego_lane_at_start == ego_lane_start)
                keep(it.gen_ego_lane_at_end == ego_lane_target)
                keep(it.ego_start_offset == start_offset)
                keep(it.ego_driving_duration == duration_time)
            
            # 目标车道后方NPC(在盲区)
            npc_driving_phase: sut.npc_free_driving() with:
                keep(it.npc_relative_position == self.npc_relative_position)
                keep(it.npc_initial_speed == npc_speed)
                keep(it.npc_initial_lane == npc_lane)
                keep(it.npc_target_lane == npc_lane)
                keep(it.npc_duration == duration_time)
                keep(it.ref_car == sut.car)

    do sut.blind_merge_test_run()

    const test_index: string

extend test_config:
    set test_name = "blind_merge_test_run"
    set additional_parameters.test_index = "auto_20251121_000007"

instances.input: Ego speed is 50 km/h, and vehicles on both sides are overtaking at 60 km/h.

# 测试场景: 双重超车
# 描述: 测试两侧车道都有车辆从后方超越时的感知和安全性
# 场景: 三车道道路,自车在中间车道,左右两侧车道都有车辆从后方快速接近

import "$PROJECT_DIR/projectLibs/project_scenario_base/project_base_scenario_model_ssp.osc"
import "$OSC2LIB/scenarios/free_drive/ego_free_drive_auto_gen/ego_free_drive_auto_gen_one_way_road_top.osc"
import "$OSC2LIB/scenarios/free_drive/npc_driving/npc_free_driving_top.osc"

extend test_config:
    set map = "$OSC2LIB/maps/M499_FTX_suburban.xodr"

scenario sut.dualpass_test_run inherits project_base_scenario:
    keep(default scenario_str_generic == "dualpass_test_run")
    
    # 测试道路
    my_road: one_way_road
    
    # 自车车道 (至少2,确保有左右车道)
    ego_lane: int with:
        keep(it >= 2)

    # NPC车道 (相邻车道)
    npc_lane: int with:
        keep(it >= 1)
        keep(default it in [ego_lane - 1, ego_lane + 1])

    # 自车速度
    ego_speed: speed with:
        keep(default it == 40kph)

    # NPC速度 (比自车快)
    npc_speed: speed with:
        keep(default it == 50kph)

    # NPC相对距离 (负值表示在后方)
    npc_relative_distance: length with:
        keep(default it in [-20m..-10m])

    # 起始偏移
    start_offset: length with:
        keep(it <= my_road.length - 200m)

    # 测试持续时间
    duration_time: time with:
        keep(it >= 15s)

    keep(sut.car.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.allow_opposite_left_side == true)

    on @set_up.start:
        call logger.log_info("Ego speed: $(ego_speed)")
        call logger.log_info("NPC speed: $(npc_speed)")
        call logger.log_info("Initial gap (NPC behind Ego): $(npc_relative_distance)")
        call logger.log_info("Scenario duration: $(duration_time)")

    do serial():
        set_up: parallel():
            # 自车在中间车道行驶
            ego_free_drive_phase: sut.ego_free_drive_auto_gen_one_way_road() with:
                keep(it.gen_ego_speed_at_start == ego_speed)
                keep(it.ego_road_element == my_road)
                keep(it.gen_min_lanes == 3)
                keep(it.gen_ego_lane_at_start == ego_lane)
                keep(it.gen_ego_lane_at_end == ego_lane)
                keep(it.ego_start_offset == start_offset)
                keep(it.ego_driving_duration == duration_time)

            # 左侧车道NPC车辆
            npc_driving_left: sut.npc_free_driving() with:
                keep(it.npc_relative_position == npc_relative_distance)
                keep(it.npc_initial_speed == npc_speed)
                keep(it.npc_target_speed == npc_speed)
                keep(it.npc_initial_lane == ego_lane - 1)
                keep(it.npc_target_lane == ego_lane - 1)
                keep(it.npc_duration == duration_time)
                keep(it.ref_car == sut.car)

            # 右侧车道NPC车辆
            npc_driving_right: sut.npc_free_driving() with:
                keep(it.npc_relative_position == npc_relative_distance)
                keep(it.npc_initial_speed == npc_speed)
                keep(it.npc_target_speed == npc_speed)
                keep(it.npc_initial_lane == ego_lane + 1)
                keep(it.npc_target_lane == ego_lane + 1)
                keep(it.npc_duration == duration_time)
                keep(it.ref_car == sut.car)

scenario sut.blind_right_ped_bike_test_run:
    # 道路弯曲参数
    max_radius: length with:
        keep(soft it <= 150m)

    min_radius: length with:
        keep(soft it == 5m)

    curve_direction: curve_direction with:
        keep(soft it == right_curve)

    min_road_length: length with:
        keep(soft it >= 120m)


    start_offset: length with:
        keep(soft it in [10m..20m])
    
    # 定义弯道
    curved_road: road_curvature with:
        keep(it.max_radius == self.max_radius)
        keep(it.min_radius == self.min_radius)
        keep(it.direction == self.curve_direction)
        keep(it.length > self.min_road_length)

    lon_offset_person : length with:
        keep(soft it in [10m..50m])

    lon_offset_cyclist : length with:
        keep(soft it in [lon_offset_person-5m .. lon_offset_person+5m])

    lat_offset : length with:
        keep(soft it == [-3m..0m])

    # 脆弱道路使用者: 行人
    vru_person: person
    vru_person_position: msp_position
    position_along_drive(
        vru_person_position, 
        sut_drive, 
        path_fraction: 0, 
        lon_offset: lon_offset_person, 
        lat_offset: lat_offset
    )
    
    # 脆弱道路使用者: 自行车
    vru_cyclist: cyclist
    vru_cyclist_position: msp_position
    position_along_drive(
        vru_cyclist_position, 
        sut_drive, 
        path_fraction: 0, 
        lon_offset: lon_offset_cyclist, 
        lat_offset: lat_offset
    )

    duration_time: time  with:
        keep(default it in [5s..10s])
    
    do parallel():
        # 自车沿弯道行驶
        sut_drive: sut.car.drive() with:
            along(curved_road, start_offset: start_offset, at: start)
            duration(duration_time, run_mode: best_effort)
        
        # 行人和自行车出现在指定位置
        vru_person.exists_at(vru_person_position)
        vru_cyclist.exists_at(vru_cyclist_position)

        keep(it >= 1)
    
    # NPC目标车道
    npc_target_lane: int with:
        keep(it >= 1)
        keep(default it in [ego_lane - 1, ego_lane + 1])

    # 起始偏移
    start_offset: length with:
        keep(it <= my_road.length - 200m)

    # 行驶速度
    drive_speed: speed with:
        keep(default it == 40kph)

    # NPC相对位置
    npc_relative_position: length with:
        keep(default it == 10m)

    # 变道开始时间
    lane_change_start_time: time with:
        keep(default it in [0s..1s])

    # 变道持续时间
    lane_change_duration: time with:
        keep(default it in [3s..4s])

    # 障碍物相对位置
    obstacle_relative_position: length with:
        keep(default it == 44m)

    # 测试持续时间
    duration_time: time with:
        keep(it >= lane_change_start_time + lane_change_duration + 3s)

    keep(sut.car.ftx_driver.bypass_behavior.allow_opposite_left_side == true)

    on @set_up.start:
        call logger.log_info("Ego / NPC speed:         $(drive_speed)")
        call logger.log_info("NPC rel pos:             $(npc_relative_position)")
        call logger.log_info("NPC lane change: start   $(lane_change_start_time)  dur $(lane_change_duration)")
        call logger.log_info("Static obstacle rel pos: $(obstacle_relative_position)")
        call logger.log_info("Scenario duration:       $(duration_time)")
        call logger.log_info("Ego lane: $(ego_lane)  NPC target lane: $(npc_target_lane)")

    do serial():
        set_up: parallel():
            # 自车自由行驶阶段
            ego_free_drive_phase: sut.ego_free_drive_auto_gen_one_way_road() with:
                keep(it.gen_ego_speed_at_start == drive_speed)
                keep(it.ego_road_element == my_road)
                keep(it.gen_min_lanes == 2)
                keep(it.gen_ego_lane_at_start == ego_lane)
                keep(it.ego_start_offset == start_offset)
                keep(it.ego_driving_duration == duration_time)

            # NPC切出阶段
            npc_cut_out_phase: sut.npc_cut_out() with:
                keep(it.npc_relative_position == npc_relative_position)
                keep(it.npc_initial_speed == drive_speed)
                keep(it.npc_target_speed == drive_speed)
                keep(it.npc_initial_lane == ego_lane)
                keep(it.npc_target_lane == npc_target_lane)
                keep(it.npc_cut_out_start_time == lane_change_start_time)
                keep(it.npc_cut_out_duration == lane_change_duration)
                keep(it.npc_duration == duration_time)
                keep(it.ref_car == sut.car)

            # 静止障碍物阶段
            obstacle_phase: sut.npc_free_driving() with:
                keep(it.npc_relative_position == obstacle_relative_position)
                keep(it.npc_initial_speed == 0kph)
                keep(it.npc_target_speed == 0kph)
                keep(it.npc_initial_lane == ego_lane)
                keep(it.npc_target_lane == ego_lane)
                keep(it.npc_duration == duration_time)
                keep(it.ref_car == sut.car)
